study_strategy.look_here_first: Start with growth form, then inflorescence architecture: woody shrub vs herb, loose spike vs dense head, then leaf texture/width and calyx details.

quick_key.if: low intricately branched woody shrub + many tiny leaflets
herbaceous + long slender loose spike with separated flowers/bracts
herbaceous + dense fuzzy/sericeous head + conspicuously silky few-foliolate leaves
herbaceous + narrow linear leaflets + dense swollen cylindrical/ovoid head
quick_key.then: Dalea compacta — confirm against D. purpurea at the calyx

priority_confuser.note: Do not separate primarily by flower color; Barneby places the strongest differential in the calyx.

taxonomy_note: Dalea compacta is retained at species level while documenting Kew's two accepted varieties (var. compacta and var. pubescens); Hill Country evidence strongly represents var. pubescens.
